列表页的批量导入和导出，只支持 CSV 和 XLSX。ImportDialog: Bulk import and export for list pages, CSV and XLSX only. ImportDialog downloads the template, picks the file and shows the result; when the API reports bad rows nothing is imported, and the dialog shows how many rows failed and offers the details as a download, with nothing for the page to handle. ExportDialog picks the fields and the file format; the page states the scope (the selected rows or everything) through ruleHint and sends ids in the request. The examples below use mock APIs and don't really import or export anything.
onImport 返回 Promise，resolve { message, c: onImport returns a Promise; once it resolves with { message, created, updated } the dialog shows how many rows were added and updated, and onImported reports it and reloads the list. Try it with any CSV or XLSX file.
接口返回 400 { error, error_rows, error_coun: When the API answers 400 { error, error_rows, error_count }, reject with that body as is: the dialog shows the error and the number of failed rows, and offers the details as a download.
勾选行时只导出勾选的数据，否则导出全部；字段和文件格式在对话框里选。onConf: With rows selected only those are exported, otherwise everything; the fields and the file format are picked in the dialog. onConfirm handles failures itself and closes the dialog only on success.
导入失败，存在错误数据: Import failed: some rows are invalid
打开 / 关闭时调用；导入进行中不能关闭: Called on open / close; it can't close while importing
标题（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Title (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
导入到哪里，显示在说明里: Where the rows go, shown in the description
下载所选格式的模板；不传时按钮不可用: Downloads the template in the picked format; without it the button is disabled
上传文件：成功时 resolve { message, created, upd: Uploads the file: resolve with { message, created, updated } on success, reject with the API's error body (ImportFailure) on failure
导入成功后调用，一般提示结果并刷新列表: Called after a successful import; usually reports the result and reloads the list
失败明细的文件名: File name of the failure details
可以上传的扩展名（不带点）: Extensions that can be uploaded (without the dot)
模板格式选项，value 传给 onDownloadTemplate: Template format choices; value is passed to onDownloadTemplate
默认选中的模板格式: The template format picked at first
成功的响应：新增和更新的条数: The success body: how many rows were added and updated
失败的响应（400），整批回滚；对话框显示 error 和失败行数: The failure body (400), with the whole batch rolled back; the dialog shows error and the number of failed rows
最多 500 行 { line, reason, row }，可以下载为 CSV: Up to 500 rows of { line, reason, row }, downloadable as CSV
失败行的总数（可能超过 error_rows 的长度）: Total number of failed rows (may exceed the length of error_rows)
打开 / 关闭时调用；导出进行中不能关闭: Called on open / close; it can't close while exporting
说明导出范围，例如勾选的行还是全部数据: States what is exported, e.g. the selected rows or all data
可导出的字段：label 是中文原文，value 是接口的字段名: Fields that can be exported: label is the Chinese source text, value the API's field name
打开时勾选的字段；空数组表示全部勾选: Fields checked when the dialog opens; an empty array checks them all
执行导出；Promise 结束前按钮显示加载。组件不处理失败，也不会自己关闭：成: Runs the export; the button shows a spinner until the Promise settles. The component neither handles failures nor closes itself: the page closes it on success
